events.title: Agriculture Festival
events.summary: Local farmers sell fresh produce, display a treasure boat made of autumn vegetables, and host gaming events.

events.title: Nishifu Culture Center Community Festival
events.summary: Local groups exhibit pottery, bonsai, and chrysanthemums alongside stage performances and a raffle.

events.title: Tamagawa Basin Local Performing Arts Festival and Products Fair

events.summary: Enjoy traditional regional performing arts and regional product stalls from municipalities along the Tamagawa River.
